message.content: {"research_brief": "How can I reconstruct, using only evidence returned by the benchmark tools as of October 1, 2026, the Pandora Papers public reporting on King Abdullah II of Jordan’s alleged offshore property network, including the identities and relationships of the king, shell companies, intermediaries and advisers, relevant jurisdictions, and luxury real-estate locations; trace how each entity, person, company, jurisdiction, and property is connected; distinguish directly documented facts from journalistic allegations, analytical assessments, and unresolved uncertainty; avoid inventing or inferring unsupported facts; cite exclusively the source IDs returned by the tools; and present the results as a complete readable Markdown report followed by one fenced JSON object containing arrays named `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, where every finding includes `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`, every claim includes `claim` and `source_references`, every reasoning step includes `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`, and every contradiction includes `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`, using entity IDs and relationship names only when explicitly supported by tool-returned evidence and reporting uncertainty or omitting unsupported items?"}
